'''Physical Status''' is a category of debuffs applied to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an operator attempts to apply a type of Physical Status to an enemy that is not currently {{G|Vulnerable}}, a stack of Vulnerability is applied instead. Otherwise, the effects based on the type of Physical Status is triggered.

Some Physical Statuses such as {{G|Lift}} and {{G|Knock Down}} can be <u>forcibly applied</u> to trigger '''Lifted''' and '''Knocked Down''' respectively without requiring the enemy to be Vulnerable.

Applying a Physical Status to an enemy affected by {{G|Solidification}} consumes the Solidification and applies {{G|Shatter}}: Deals {{Color|240 — 600% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} of the triggering operator based on the {{G|Status Level}} of the Solidification.
{{TOC limit|3}}
{{Clr}}
== Types ==
A '''Physical Status''' can be one of the following types:

{{Icon|Lift icon|'''[[Lift]]'''}}
* If the target is Vulnerable, deals {{Color|120% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} of the triggering operator, applies {{Color|10|8}} Stagger, and applies a stack of Vulnerability.
** Weaker enemies are '''Lifted''' into the air and are unable to act for {{Color|1|1d}} second. Some operators such as {{Icon|Chen Qianyu icon|[[Chen Qianyu]]}} are able to lift the enemy for a longer duration.
** Stronger enemies are not lifted but will continue to receive the additional damage, stagger, and Vulnerability debuff.
** Lifted can be <u>forcibly applied</u> by some operators without requiring the enemy to be Vulnerable.

{{Icon|Knock Down icon|'''[[Knock Down]]'''}}
* If the target is Vulnerable, deals {{Color|120% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} of the triggering operator, applies {{Color|10|8}} Stagger, and applies a stack of Vulnerability.
** Weaker enemies are '''Knocked Down''' and are unable to act for {{Color|1|1d}} second.
** Stronger enemies are immune to the crowd control effect but will continue to receive the additional damage, stagger, and Vulnerability debuff.
** Knocked Down can be <u>forcibly applied</u> by some operators without requiring the enemy to be Vulnerable.

{{Icon|Crush icon|'''[[Crush]]'''}}
* If the target is Vulnerable, applies '''Crushed''': Consumes all Vulnerability stacks and deals {{Color|300% - 750% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} of the triggering operator based on the number of stacks consumed.
* Some skills such as {{Icon|Mi Fu icon|[[Mi Fu]]'s}} {{Color|World Splitter|7}} deal their damage as Crush DMG and are increased by [[Arts Intensity]] but not {{G|Link}} or Battle Skill DMG Bonus. This damage is not considered as being '''Crushed''' or as applying a Physical Status for the purposes of {{Icon|Pogranichnik icon|[[Pogranichnik]]'s}} {{Color|Shieldguard Banner, Forward|7}}.

{{Icon|Breach icon|'''[[Breach]]'''}}
* If the target is Vulnerable, applies '''Breached''': Consumes all Vulnerability stacks, deals {{Color|100% - 250% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} of the triggering operator based on the number of stacks consumed. While the debuff is active, {{Color|Additional Physical DMG Taken|2}} {{Color|+12 - 24%|1d}} based on the number of stacks consumed.

==Changelog==
{{Changelog|
* '''Beta Test II'''
** '''Vulnerable''' is now '''Vulnerability'''. Vulnerability now stacks up to four times on a target.
** '''Breach''' added.
** <u>Forcibly applied</u> '''Lift''' and '''Knock Down''' added.
*** No longer requires the target to be Vulnerable in order to apply their effects.
** '''Lift''' and '''Knock Down''' changed.
*** No longer consumes Vulnerable if the target is already Vulnerable. Instead, adds a stack of Vulnerability.
** '''Knock Back''' changed.
*** Renamed as '''Crush'''. Damage is now variable based on the number of Vulnerability stacks consumed.

* '''Beta Test I'''
** '''Lift''', '''Knock Down''', and '''Knock Back''' added.
*** When an operator applies the Physical Status to a Vulnerable enemy, consume the debuff to deal additional Physical DMG and apply Stagger. If the enemy is not Vulnerable, applies Vulnerable instead.
}}
